about: Real-meeting numbers for docs/charts.py. The meeting recordings are private, so the charts never read results/meetings/ or data/; these are the aggregate numbers already published in the docs, copied as they are written there. Each block says where it is published, and tests/test_charts.py checks that it still matches. A table block gives, for each row (named by its first cell), every number in the rest of that row in order, with null for an empty cell. A quote block gives numbers that appear in that order in the quoted text. Percentages are in percent, speed is processing time divided by audio length, memory is in GB.
